notes.title: Patch fixes for Pandemic Love (v. 1.1g.)
notes.content:
First. Thanks to everyone that has written to me here on Steam or on other platforms. The respons to this little game has been overwhelming. I don't really know what to write...

Second. Pandemic Love has been updated to v. 1.1g.
[list]
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug during one of the paths in the later part of the game.
[*]Fixed a few spelling errors.
[*]Made minor changes to some of the dialogues to make them flow better.
[*]No gameplay changes, no story changes.
[/list]
